machine: Mac M1 - 8-core CPU, 7-core GPU, 16 GB, macOS 26.6.2
scene: spec/mvp/mvp.toml - 547 objects, 3641 polys, 2 suns, no volumetrics
findings: Metal was SLOWER than CPU on this scene: 3.91 vs 3.00 s/frame. The M1's 7-core GPU is weak and per-frame overhead dominates on a simple scene. Do not assume the Mac's GPU is the fast path - measure it.
Scaling with pixel count is close to linear: 1.565x the pixels gave 1.49x the time. That makes the extrapolation below defensible for THIS scene.
This is a deliberately simple scene. Volumetrics, displacement and high-poly instancing will change the picture completely.

extrapolation.method: linear in pixels and samples from the 384x682 @ 8 spp CPU row. This is an OPTIMISTIC lower bound: it ignores VRAM pressure and out-of-core fallback.

not_measured: RTX 3080 / OptiX throughput - the number that actually governs the schedule. UNKNOWN.

next_actions: Run this same scene on the Windows node with --device OPTIX and fill in the 3080 row. Until that exists, every schedule claim in ROADMAP.md is an estimate.
